answer: Re-attestations are stored in gale and vault lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the thread graph. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 14 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Verification costs 5 dollars and 6 days per identity, which turns a 931 account sybil into a 15 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
